meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 搜索 X(Twitter)帖子时按规则发查询:给时效性问题加日期范围、限定可信账号、拆成 2~3 次搜索,并与网页搜索对照。汇报时每条说法附上 x.com 链接,注明是某账号的帖子而非事实。
howto.when: 当你提到「X 搜索」「Twitter 搜索」「推文」等关键词,或想看 X 上的社交信号时接管;前提是已连接 xAI 账号,未连接时会说明工具不可用并转用网页搜索。

say.text: 用 x_search 查一下昨天关于英伟达的 X 帖子
say.note: 从昨天起的日期范围搜索,附 x.com 链接

say.text: 只搜 @growth_papa 这些可信账号最近发的推文
say.note: 用 allowed_x_handles 限定账号,单独跑一轮

say.text: 把 X 上的说法和网页搜索结果对照,冲突的都告诉我
say.note: 会分别说明只有 X 有、只有网页有的说法

howto.what_en: It makes Claude search X (Twitter) via the x_search tool: date-bound time-sensitive queries, scope trusted accounts, split into 2–3 passes, reconcile with web_search. Claims get an x.com link and are labelled as posts, not facts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention X search, Twitter search, tweets, or social signal — and only when an xAI account is connected; otherwise it says x_search is unavailable and falls back to web_search.

say_en.text: Search X for posts about Nvidia from yesterday using x_search
say_en.note: Runs a search dated from yesterday and cites x.com links

say_en.text: Only search these trusted accounts for recent tweets: @growth_papa
say_en.note: Scopes the search with allowed_x_handles in a separate pass

say_en.text: Compare the X results with web_search and flag any conflicts
say_en.note: Reports X-only and web-only claims separately
